reviewer: Codex corpus-author agent; independent of DeepSeek provider response, not independent of reference authorship and not a human study
scope: First replies for eight authored synthetic projects / nine source criteria; no retries, reference changes, external projects or generic accuracy estimate.

classificationPolicy.accepted: Whole published/raw answer is source-grounded, in locked scope and honest about evidence level.
classificationPolicy.qualified: Core status/action remains reasonable but a specific non-blocking wording, relevance or actionability issue remains.
classificationPolicy.rejected: At least one important status or active claim/repair direction overreaches the evidence or locked scope. Mechanical report admission is distinct.

reviewNotes: The source-only supported claim is confined to the labelled p owner in index.html. Generic page-content scope does not require duplicating the telephone on contact.html.
No rendered visibility or phone ownership is claimed in the published item.
The limited static-copy omission and proposed phone repair are supported by both complete plain documents.

The raw/published risk title incorrectly calls contact.html the only text-bearing page; index.html also contains an h1 and paragraph. Keep this precision issue visible despite the correct item status.
The body address owner genuinely establishes email source copy and the supported item status is correct.
The item nevertheless calls the address copy visible despite no browser observation.

The first optional risk raises absent email on contact.html even though the locked generic page-content requirement is already satisfied on index.html; its conditional suggestion is additional scope, not an evidenced delivery defect.
The second optional risk treats explicitly archived/commented and diagnostic JSON strings as a potential defect without an agreed requirement to remove such source data.
Because no item status changed, these leads remain published rather than quarantined; this is a real optional-risk scope/wording quality gap, not a false citation.
The raw answer asserts no page visibly lists an email and proposes definite repair while its own limitations acknowledge that the external widget code/output is unsupplied.

The application correctly changes this to source-evidence uncertainty and retains both original optional leads separately under the report-wide gate. It does not assert email absence, run a browser or mark the item passed.
The named-page omission is correctly distinguished from the real telephone owner on contact.html; the item and repair lead are source-supported.
A raw limitation unnecessarily speculates about dynamically injected text after noting that no script files are declared. This raw limitation is not published as a detected fact.
The raw answer and the canonical application comparison keep Tea/Coffee owners and index/menu pages separate.
The exact source mismatch is Tea AUD24 on menu.html against the buyer-confirmed AUD18; nearby Coffee AUD18 does not substitute. Runtime pricing is not claimed.
Both criterion statuses are correct: actual submission/email/write/restart readback remain unverified, whereas the literal Submission heading is supported copy.

The raw limitations mention referenced/omitted scripts despite this fixture declaring none; this is imprecise coverage wording, not proof of execution or a missing implementation. The application keeps only fixed inventory/coverage notes.
Saved obligations distinguish the actual operation directions and leave all execution_not_verified; the quoted label has only source_content and does not invent a submission operation.
The raw supported verdict cherry-picks AUD18 while the same Tea rowspan also owns AUD28. A confirmed amount alone does not settle which price applies to the agreed order.

The application correctly withholds a supported conclusion under complex-source uncertainty. Its explanation remains generic: a more useful result would state that Tea already relates to both rows and ask which price/option applies, rather than only listing possible source complexities.

remainingActualIssues: body-email-with-decoys: unobserved visible wording and extra-scope published contact/debug-email repair leads
merged-row: safe unknown still lacks precise which-price-applies question
limits: This review is not independent of the corpus/reference author. Obtain a separate reviewer of raw and application answers before presenting independent whole-answer counts.
Exact quotes and reference-status agreement do not eliminate semantic or optional-risk errors.
Quarantined original provider leads are retained evidence, not published confirmed defects.
